note: Welsh river level gauges. low/high is the middle half of everything the gauge recorded over the twelve months named in from/to — the levels it sat between for half of that time. COMPUTED BY THIS SITE, not published by Natural Resources Wales, who publish no typical range of any kind; the page says so. One year is one year, so unlike Scotland there is no figure per calendar month and no seasonal claim is made. Positions are converted from British National Grid, which is all NRW give.
